notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Black plates with white characters, usually split into two blocks, visible even through blur.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Double white centre lines on two-lane roads, unique in Southeast Asia.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Thick yellow bars across the road, almost exclusive here.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Utility poles carry black or white stickers, sometimes with red-white or red-blue stripes below.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Stop signs read BERHENTI and yield signs read BERI LALUAN, unique wording.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Bollards mixing black, white, grey and red.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Yellow hexagonal highway shields, found nowhere else.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: White-and-blue kilometre markers, usually with the hexagon shield.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Latin-script language almost identical to that of the neighbouring island giant; Chinese characters are also common, unlike in that country.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Sign posts are almost always striped black and white.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Black-and-white curbs are common.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Arrow-shaped street name signs, in any colour, are exclusive to this country.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Each state has a road-number letter prefix; the federal territories do not.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Black pole stickers are mostly on the mainland; those marked TEL TNB are only in the south.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: White pole stickers are only on Borneo, in Sarawak.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Poles with a 2-1 insulator layout and a long diagonal wooden brace are exclusive to Sarawak.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Thin metal poles with two parallel tops exist only in Sabah.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Green arrow street signs with a yellow hexagon and JKR letters are found in Sabah.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Sabah is very mountainous, with many mountain roads; Sarawak is flatter.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Yellow street name signs with a black outline mark the southern state of Johor.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Bin logos vary by state: an S shape in the south, leaves in the northwest, and Alam Flora in the central area.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Isolated rock outcrops rising from flat land near the northern border.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Blue cylindrical containers dot the urban areas of one island territory.
